Some pharmacopoeias include a single monograph that permits both the light and heavy varieties while some have 2 separate monographs for the 2 varieties. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Magnesium Carbonate, Heavy; Magnesii Subcarbo- nas Ponderosus). A hydrated basic magnesium carbonate con- taining the equivalent of 40 to 45% of MgO. A white or almost white powder. 15 g has an apparent volume before settling of not more than 60 mL. Practically insoluble in water; dissolves in di- lute acids with strong effervescence. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Magnesium Carbonate, Light; Magnesii Subcarbo- nas Levis). A hydrated basic magnesium carbonate containing the equivalent of 40 to 45% of MgO.
